azurerm_site_recovery_replication_policy.policy already references azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault through `recovery_vault_name = azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault.name`, so the explicit `depends_on = [azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault]` is redundant.
azurerm_express_route_gateway.er_gateway sets `virtual_hub_id = azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id`, so the explicit `depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub]` duplicates the implicit dependency.
azurerm_vpn_gateway.s2s_gateway sets `virtual_hub_id = azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id`, so the explicit `depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub]` duplicates the implicit dependency.

azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway sets `virtual_hub_id = azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id`, so the explicit `depends_on` entry on azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub duplicates the implicit dependency.

azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway sets `vpn_server_configuration_id = azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration[0].id`, so the explicit `depends_on` entry on azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration duplicates the implicit dependency.

null_resource.grant_admin_consent already references azuread_service_principal.app (e.g. `principalId = azuread_service_principal.app.id`), so the explicit `depends_on = [azuread_service_principal.app]` is redundant.

data.external.ase_ilb_ip already references azurerm_template_deployment.ase in its `program` (via `azurerm_template_deployment.ase.outputs`), so the explicit `depends_on = [azurerm_template_deployment.ase]` is redundant.

azurerm_virtual_hub_connection.vhub_connection already references module.virtual_wans (via `module.virtual_wans[...].virtual_hubs[...].id` in `virtual_hub_id`), so depending on `module.virtual_wans` explicitly is redundant. (The `module.networking` entry is still needed since that dependency runs only through the `combined_objects_networking` local.)

The AKS cluster enables managed Azure AD integration (`role_based_access_control { azure_active_directory { managed = true } }`), which in this provider version requires the AAD-V2 feature to be registered first. null_resource.register_aks_msi_preview_feature exists to register that feature (and can take ~30 minutes), but azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks has neither an attribute reference nor a `depends_on` to it, so the cluster may be created before the feature registration completes and fail. Add an explicit dependency from the cluster to the feature-registration resource.
